- ![Android](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ExpTechTW/DPIP/main/.github/assets/android.svg) ![iOS](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ExpTechTW/DPIP/main/.github/assets/ios.svg) 修正啟動早期的紀錄從來沒被存下來，當機時最該看的那幾行都不見 — @whes1015 ([`c5fdbd31`](https://github.com/ExpTechTW/DPIP/commit/c5fdbd31a242f6c57cb98731e473cab37d0b1b94))
